Task: Write a CloudFormation template provisioning an ECS Fargate cluster running two microservices behind an internal Network Load Balancer.

Output only the AWS CloudFormation (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: ECS Fargate cluster running two microservices behind an internal Network Load Balancer

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: production
    Description: Environment name used for tagging and resource naming
  VpcId:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC::Id
    Description: VPC where resources will be deployed
  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Type: List<AWS::EC2::Subnet::Id>
    Description: List of private subnets (minimum 2 in different AZs) for ECS tasks and NLB
  ServiceOneImage:
    Type: String
    Description: Container image URI for service one (e.g., ECR URI with tag)
  ServiceTwoImage:
    Type: String
    Description: Container image URI for service two (e.g., ECR URI with tag)
  ServiceOnePort:
    Type: Number
    Default: 8080
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 65535
  ServiceTwoPort:
    Type: Number
    Default: 8081
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 65535
  ServiceOneDesiredCount:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2
    MinValue: 1
  ServiceTwoDesiredCount:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2
    MinValue: 1
  TaskCpu:
    Type: String
    Default: '512'
    AllowedValues: ['256', '512', '1024', '2048', '4096']
  TaskMemory:
    Type: String
    Default: '1024'
    AllowedValues: ['512', '1024', '2048', '4096', '8192']
  LogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    AllowedValues: [1, 3, 5, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 180, 365]
  AllowedClientCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/8
    Description: CIDR block allowed to reach the internal NLB
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$

Resources:

  ECSCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-ecs-cluster
      CapacityProviders:
        - FARGATE
        - FARGATE_SPOT
      DefaultCapacityProviderStrategy:
        - CapacityProvider: FARGATE
          Weight: 1
          Base: 1
      ClusterSettings:
        - Name: containerInsights
          Value: enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  ECSTaskExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-ecs-task-execution-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  ServiceOneTaskRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-service-one-task-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  ServiceTwoTaskRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-service-two-task-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  ServiceOneLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /ecs/${EnvironmentName}/service-one
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionInDays

  ServiceTwoLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /ecs/${EnvironmentName}/service-two
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionInDays

  NLBSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for internal NLB (allows traffic from clients)
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref ServiceOnePort
          ToPort: !Ref ServiceOnePort
          CidrIp: !Ref AllowedClientCidr
          Description: Allow client traffic to service one
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref ServiceTwoPort
          ToPort: !Ref ServiceTwoPort
          CidrIp: !Ref AllowedClientCidr
          Description: Allow client traffic to service two
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
          Description:
